title: My 5 Favorite Laptops Are Deeply Discounted for Prime Day
gist: Wired's laptop Prime Day picks note that laptop prices rose significantly over six months due to the memory shortage, with Apple raising Mac prices in June; MacBook Air M5 at $1,099 is the best deal, while Windows on Snapdragon dominates the value picks.

insights.claim: Laptop prices have risen significantly over the past six months because of a memory shortage, which led Apple to raise Mac prices in June.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Memory-supply tightness is passing through to PC and Mac pricing, a margin and demand watch item for OEMs and memory makers.
insights.quote: The memory shortage wreaked havoc on prices, even causing Apple to hike them up in June.

insights.claim: The $200 discount on the MacBook Air (M5, 2026) to $1,099 for all Amazon configurations effectively reverses Apple's June price hike and is the cheapest since June.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Retailer-funded discounts, not Apple list-price cuts, are offsetting memory-driven price increases.

insights.claim: The reviewer ranks the M5 MacBook Air not only as the best MacBook but as the best overall laptop of any kind.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Apple's laptop lead on performance and value supports the Mac franchise.

insights.claim: Neither the MacBook Neo nor the MacBook Pro is being discounted by anything out of the ordinary.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.locator: Not only is this the MacBook I recommend

insights.claim: The 2026 Surface Laptop 13.8-inch at $1,280 is cheaper by $500 than list and justified because the Snapdragon X2 Elite GPU is significantly better than the X1.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Qualcomm's X2 generation is delivering real GPU gains, supporting Windows-on-Arm.

insights.claim: HP's OmniBook 5 with a Snapdragon X chip has an OLED screen, MacBook Neo-thin chassis and strong battery life, dropping to $750 for 16-inch on Amazon.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Qualcomm's Arm chips are now powering the budget Windows leader.

insights.claim: Asus's 2026 Zenbook A14 is too expensive and not discounted, so the reviewer recommends the previous model with Snapdragon X Plus, 16 GB RAM, and 512 GB for value.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: New-generation Windows laptops carry higher starting prices, pushing buyers to older stock.

insights.claim: The Lenovo LOQ 15 (RTX 5050, 1 TB) was $1,100, the lowest in many months, and is favored for a good display among budget gaming laptops.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Budget gaming laptops still carry Nvidia RTX 50-series GPUs at around $1,100.
